yaml:
name: Rebuild Model Site

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          all_but_latest: true
          only_status: "in_progress"

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed_files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json
          filter: '^(policyengine_us/parameters/indiana_tanf/.*\.json|policyengine_us/variables/.*\.py|policyengine_us/tests/.*\.py)$'

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          activate-environment: ''
          ignore-empty-workdir: true
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run tests
        if: steps.changed_files.outputs.modified != ''
        run: uv run pytest -q

      - name: Build model site
        if: steps.changed_files.outputs.modified != ''
        run: uv run python -m policyengine build
